impact: runSetup() creates ~/.zug/ but writes no PERSONA.md or PLAYBOOK.md. A new user's first call to zug_get_context returns nothing. No prompt or guidance to run zug onboard. The tool appears broken.
resolution: runSetup() now writes PERSONA.md template from embedded PERSONA_TEMPLATE_CONTENT constant if the file does not exist. Includes instructions and section prompts. Also prints 'run zug onboard to seed your cognitive fingerprint' on first setup.
title: zug setup does not seed PERSONA.md — first zug_get_context returns empty
